description: This file defines a React component named CostsOrganizationSummary that displays an organization summary including ID, name, total cost, and user count. It includes loading and error states, uses mock data fetching, and styles for presentation.

methods.name: SummaryItem
methods.description: A React component that renders a label and value pair with styling, used within CostsOrganizationSummary.

methods.name: mockFetchOrganizationSummary
methods.description: A mock asynchronous function simulating fetching organization summary data, with optional failure.

methods.name: delay
methods.description: A utility function that returns a promise resolving after a specified delay in milliseconds.
